Name: XIV Helper
Author: jeoffersondelapena
Punchline: Keeps the overlays up, reads out the Mac's notes, and minds the character on BOCCHI runs.
Description: Asks IINACT and Browsingway how they are, restarts whichever layer is unwell, loads either plugin if it is missing, and relays the notes the Mac-side watchers leave, at login and every half hour until cleared. While BOCCHI runs there it also accepts a raise, thanks the raiser in /say, and returns to camp after a set time dead with no raise, and with /helper horn on it takes the character back into South Horn after the instance timer and restarts BOCCHI.
